keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «박명대는 지구의 기후를 조절하는 데에도 도움을 준다(핵심 사실)» 과 «박명대를 지키는 일은 바다 생물뿐 아니라 지구의 미래에도 중요할 수 있다(결론)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the key fact (the twilight zone also helps to control Earth’s climate) and the conclusion (protecting the twilight zone may be important not only for ocean life but also for the future of our planet). The green sentences are the answers.

qs.q: Why is it too dark for plants to grow in the twilight zone?
qs.qko: 박명대는 왜 식물이 자라기에 너무 어두울까요?
opts: Because only a small amount of sunlight reaches it
Because the water there is too cold for plants
Because animals eat all the plants at night
evs: Others produce their own light, a skill called bioluminescence, to find food, attract partners, or confuse predators.
Only a small amount of sunlight reaches this layer, so it is too dark for plants to grow.
Surprisingly, the twilight zone also helps to control Earth's climate.
Suddenly, tiny sparks of light flash past the window.
why: 햇빛이 아주 조금만 이 층까지 닿기 때문에, 식물이 자라기에는 너무 어두워요.
Only a small amount of sunlight reaches this layer, so it is too dark for plants to grow.

qs.q: In the text, what does 'diel vertical migration' mean?
qs.qko: 글에서 'diel vertical migration(일주기 수직 이동)' 은 무슨 뜻인가요?
opts: A trip that fish take to warmer oceans once a year
Animals moving up to the surface at night and back down before sunrise every day
Light that animals make inside their own bodies
evs: At night, enormous numbers of animals swim up toward the surface to feed, and before sunrise they return to the darkness to hide from predators.
It stretches from about 200 to 1,000 meters below the surface.
Others produce their own light, a skill called bioluminescence, to find food, attract partners, or confuse predators.
Some companies are interested in catching twilight-zone fish to make fish meal, and researchers worry that this could harm the ecosystem before we fully understand it.
why: 바로 앞 문장에서 동물들이 밤에 수면 쪽으로 올라왔다가 해 뜨기 전에 어둠 속으로 돌아간다고 했어요. 그 «매일의 위아래 이동» 을 가리키는 말이에요.
The sentence before says animals swim up at night and return to the darkness before sunrise. This daily up-and-down movement is diel vertical migration.

qs.q: Why might catching too many twilight-zone fish also be bad for Earth's climate?
qs.qko: 박명대 물고기를 너무 많이 잡으면 왜 지구의 기후에도 나쁠 수 있나요?
opts: Because the fish give off greenhouse gases at the surface
Because the fish keep the ocean water warm
Because fewer animals would carry carbon down into the deep
evs: When its animals eat near the surface and then return to the deep, they carry carbon downward, where some of it can stay for a long time.
Many of its animals are small fish, shrimp, and jellyfish that have unusual features.
Some companies are interested in catching twilight-zone fish to make fish meal, and researchers worry that this could harm the ecosystem before we fully understand it.
Below the bright, sunny surface of the ocean lies a dim and mysterious world.
why: 박명대 동물들은 탄소를 깊은 바다로 옮기는데, 물고기를 많이 잡으면 이 생태계가 망가질 수 있어요. 두 문장을 합치면 탄소를 옮기는 동물이 줄어든다는 걸 알 수 있어요.
Twilight-zone animals carry carbon down to the deep, and fishing could harm this ecosystem. Together, they suggest fewer animals would carry carbon downward.

ends: How do deep-sea animals make their own light?
깊은 바다 동물은 어떻게 스스로 빛을 낼까?
How do scientists explore the deep ocean?
